title: The rail's selection algorithm: never drop live, unread, or unreviewed work
summary: Extend spa/src/core/rail.js — the one pure module that decides which entries the side rail shows and in what order — so it can serve both rails. Add a never-drop floor (mustShow / hasUnreviewedChanges: an agent running, unread work waiting on you, or a diff you have not reviewed is always an entry, whatever its age and regardless of the backfill minimum), which also promotes agent-running and dirty never-interacted worktrees out of the Worktrees fold in the existing per-project rail. Add mainEntry() turning a project's primary_changes record plus the run that has adopted that checkout into an entry of the same shape as run/plan/worktree entries, so main branches can be rail rows. Make railEntries/railWorktrees select across every project when no projectId is given, and accept main entries as candidates. Pure, TDD in spa/test/rail.test.js; no view changes.

title: The "All" rail mode: every worktree, issue and main branch in one list
summary: Add the alternate side-rail mode: one flat list of every run, issue, worktree and project main checkout, ungrouped, selected and ordered by Stage 01's shared algorithm with one global backfill. New pure core/railMode.js (mode remembered in localStorage, defaulting to Projects) and core/allRail.js (buildAllRailModel: main rows per project, primary run lifted onto its main row, pendingDone suppression, cross-project unread count, one combined leftover Worktrees fold). Extend core/sidebar.js with a shared header carrying a Projects | All switch, an entryRow main-kind arm plus an optional project label, and allRailHtml; views/sidebar.js dispatches on the mode while every existing row handler, Done control and active-row rule stays as is; styles.css gains the switch, the project tag and the flat list. TDD in new test/railMode.test.js and test/allRail.test.js, then a browser pass with the spa:verify skill.
